sql:
CREATE TABLE rm_knowledge_page_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 page_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(page_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 80),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','superseded')),
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('workspace','company')),
 company_slug TEXT CHECK(company_slug IS NULL OR length(company_slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
 slug TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'),
 title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 240),
 body_markdown TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(body_markdown)<=20000),
 provenance_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provenance_kind IN ('user','party','corporate_record','company_knowledge','external_snapshot')),
 provenance_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(provenance_ref)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
 effective_to_exclusive TEXT,
 prior_event_hash TEXT,
 event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash)=64),
 actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
 principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK((scope_kind='workspace' AND company_slug IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='company' AND company_slug IS NOT NULL)),
 UNIQUE(page_id,version)
);
CREATE VIEW rm_current_knowledge_pages AS SELECT e.* FROM rm_knowledge_page_events e JOIN (SELECT page_id,MAX(version) version FROM rm_knowledge_page_events GROUP BY page_id) c ON c.page_id=e.page_id AND c.version=e.version;
CREATE TABLE rm_knowledge_relation_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 relation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(relation_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 80),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','superseded')),
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('workspace','company')),
 company_slug TEXT CHECK(company_slug IS NULL OR length(company_slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
 relation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_type IN ('commercial_counterparty','operational_dependency','reference')),
 subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind IN ('page','party','company')),
 subject_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(subject_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 object_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(object_kind IN ('page','party','company')),
 object_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(object_ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 provenance_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provenance_kind IN ('user','party','corporate_record','company_knowledge','external_snapshot')),
 provenance_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(provenance_ref)) BETWEEN 1 AND 512),
 effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
 effective_to_exclusive TEXT,
 prior_event_hash TEXT,
 event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash)=64),
 actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
 principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK((scope_kind='workspace' AND company_slug IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='company' AND company_slug IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(NOT(subject_kind=object_kind AND subject_ref=object_ref)),
 UNIQUE(relation_id,version)
);
CREATE VIEW rm_current_knowledge_relations AS SELECT e.* FROM rm_knowledge_relation_events e JOIN (SELECT relation_id,MAX(version) version FROM rm_knowledge_relation_events GROUP BY relation_id) c ON c.relation_id=e.relation_id AND c.version=e.version;
CREATE INDEX rm_knowledge_relation_scope ON rm_knowledge_relation_events(scope_kind,company_slug,relation_type);
CREATE TRIGGER rm_knowledge_page_current_slug_no_duplicate BEFORE INSERT ON rm_knowledge_page_events WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rm_knowledge_page_events e JOIN (SELECT page_id,MAX(version) AS version FROM rm_knowledge_page_events GROUP BY page_id) c ON c.page_id=e.page_id AND c.version=e.version WHERE e.page_id<>NEW.page_id AND e.scope_kind=NEW.scope_kind AND e.company_slug IS NEW.company_slug AND e.slug=NEW.slug) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'knowledge page slug already exists in scope'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_knowledge_page_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_knowledge_page_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'knowledge page events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_knowledge_page_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_knowledge_page_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'knowledge page events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_knowledge_relation_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rm_knowledge_relation_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'knowledge relation events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER rm_knowledge_relation_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_knowledge_relation_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'knowledge relation events are append-only'); END;
